# Eric Caskey

Senior Software Engineer at Amazon. I build the systems other engineers depend on.

Fifteen years in enterprise infrastructure. I joined Amazon in June 2022 and have held the Senior Software Engineer title since August 2024. There I architect a workflow orchestration platform whose guardrails have run 500,000 cumulative safety checks, and own the monitoring platform that keeps 3 million monitors standardized across 2,750+ application stages. From April 2013 to June 2022 I worked at Prudential Financial, moving from Remote Access Analyst to Senior Remote Access SRE to Cloud Engineer in Site Reliability Engineering. There I built the MFA self-service portal used over 18,000 times in six languages and kept the VPN running for 60,000 corporate users through the early months of COVID.

This site covers the person and the career: employment history, how to reach me, a short reading shelf. Caskey Engineering (https://caskeycoding.com) is my independent engineering practice, separate from my role at Amazon: long-form writing, the spec-driven method, and independent builds, alongside case studies of my employer work. The Amazon and Prudential work described here is employment, not Caskey Engineering client work, and implies no employer endorsement.

For independent work on AI-assisted delivery, explore Caskey Engineering: https://caskeycoding.com/#workflow-assessment

Independent builds include a spec-driven engineering platform, one engineer and a fleet of AI coding agents behind an attested merge gate, written up at https://caskeycoding.com/case-studies/sdd-platform; Ballast, an open-source RAG system with a guardrails gateway, engineered to refuse when it should; SpecSelf, a spec-driven personal operating system; and the Finance Reviewer, which presents deterministic factor scores narrated through six investor perspectives.
